answer: One agent, one customs broker licence: the national customs authority signs the epoch challenge, binding the agent's key to a single licensed broker number, re-checked against the register before it counts. A second key claiming the same licence is rejected — the authority holds the record. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 licensed brokers, each posting a $50,000 surety bond after an exam and background check: about $50,000,000 locked up, and a revoked licence kills it. A lantern for honest brokers; a comet of fake filings burns out fast, and no nectar of free keys sweetens that bill.
